identity.title: List of Pokémon Gold & Silver: The Golden Boys volumes

source.sourceCategory: Category:Pokémon Gold & Silver: The Golden Boys volumes

leadText:
This is a list of volumes of the Pokémon manga Pokémon Gold & Silver: The Golden Boys. There are three volumes in total, all of which have been translated into English by Chuang Yi.

 

 

 
 

it:Elenco dei volumi di Gold & Silver: The Golden Boys
zh:寶可夢金・銀版 黃金少年單行本列表
